entries.title: Applications page
items: 📝 The old Staff Applications tab is now **Applications**: build forms, set DM or website mode, questions with minimum length, accept/deny messages and a role.
🎟️ Ticket panels can use an **Application form** button.
⚠️ Picking a public channel as the mod log asks for confirmation.
🤖 New settings: Stop new bots on join (Protection & AutoMod).
💬 The support helper now knows all of this and far more.
